description: This source file defines a 'Card' class within a sample Android project that follows a card-based UI pattern. It includes properties for title, description, progress indicators, actions, and visual states, along with a nested Builder class for construction. The class manages UI updates, animations, and interactions for individual cards in a card stream. References to Android framework classes and specific layout resources indicate it's part of an Android app's UI component.

classes.name: Card
classes.description: Represents a UI card component with title, description, actions, progress indicator, and visual states, used within an Android application.

classes.name: Card.CardAction
classes.description: Represents an action button within a Card, including label, ID, type, and associated view.

classes.name: Card.CardProgress
classes.description: Encapsulates progress indicator settings for a Card, including type, label, current progress, and maximum value.

classes.name: Card.Builder
classes.description: Builder pattern class for constructing Card instances with customizable properties, layout, actions, and progress.
